name: Venngage
description_en:
Venngage is a browser visual-design service for infographics, reports, charts, diagrams and other communication materials. Its upgraded editor combines templates and data-driven chart editing with accessibility review tools and plan-dependent downloads, branding and team sharing. It is a design tool, not evidence of a live business-intelligence pipeline or automatic accessibility compliance.

It is useful when a team needs to explain data or processes in a branded document. The output format matters: a PNG picture does not preserve the same assistive-technology access as the documented PDF/link route. Free design access also does not imply free PNG, PDF or PowerPoint downloads.
description_zh:
Venngage 是浏览器视觉设计服务，用于信息图、报告、图表、流程图及其他沟通材料。新版编辑器结合模板、数据图表编辑及可访问性检查，下载、品牌和团队分享按套餐提供。它是设计工具，不证明具备实时商业智能管道或自动合规。

它适合用品牌文档解释数据或流程的团队。交付格式很重要：PNG图片不能保留文档中PDF/链接路线同样的辅助技术访问。免费设计访问也不意味着可免费下载PNG、PDF或PowerPoint。

sections.title_en: Explain a dataset in a designed document
sections.title_zh: 在设计文档中解释数据
sections.en:
Venngage offers infographic/report templates, charts, maps, icons and layouts, with AI assistance and brand/team tools on the relevant plans. A useful task is turning a small approved dataset into a report page with a chart and contextual explanation. It is not automatically a source-of-truth analytics system: a copied spreadsheet or imported file is a snapshot unless another verified update process is established.

Editorial fit: marketers, educators and operations teams who need visual communication can evaluate templates and reusable brand assets. A user needing reproducible statistical analysis, audited calculations or a live database dashboard should keep those computations and data controls elsewhere and verify the values shown in the design. Template polish does not validate a claim or chart encoding.
sections.zh:
Venngage提供信息图/报告模板、图表、地图、图标及布局，相应方案含AI辅助和品牌/团队工具。一个有用任务是把小型获批数据集变成带图表和解释的报告页。它不会自动成为分析权威；复制表格或导入文件属于快照，除非另建并验证更新流程。

编辑建议：营销、教育及运营团队可评估模板和可复用品牌资产。如需可重现统计、经审计计算或实时数据库看板，应在其他地方维护计算及数据控制，再核对设计显示值。模板美观不验证主张或图形编码。

sections.title_en: Import values, choose a chart and write the explanation
sections.title_zh: 导入数值、选择图形并写解释
sections.en:
The [accessible-chart guide](https://help.venngage.com/hc/en-us/articles/11013072207757-Add-a-Chart-to-Your-Accessible-Design) uses Charts in the left sidebar, then a chart type. Select the chart and use Edit Chart or double-click, open Data and enter/paste spreadsheet values. Browse Files accepts .csv or .xlsx; copying a range from Excel/Google Sheets is another route. Values update the chart on the canvas. Legend appearance and visibility are separate setup controls.

For a monthly comparison, verify category labels, units, missing values, series order and the selected chart type after import. Add a concise chart description using Alt Text in the toolbar; an AI-generated description still needs checking against the data and intended conclusion. The guide does not establish a live connection to the spreadsheet, large-dataset limits or automatic statistical correctness. No file was uploaded or values reconciled in the running editor.
sections.zh:
[可访问图表指南](https://help.venngage.com/hc/en-us/articles/11013072207757-Add-a-Chart-to-Your-Accessible-Design)从左侧Charts选图形类型开始。选中图表后点Edit Chart或双击，打开Data输入/粘贴数据；Browse Files接受.csv或.xlsx，也可从Excel/Google Sheets复制区域。数值会更新画布图表，图例外观及显示有独立设置。

月度比较应在导入后核对类别、单位、缺失值、序列顺序及图形类型，再用工具栏Alt Text添加简洁描述。AI描述仍需对照数据和预期结论核查。指南不证明与表格实时连接、大数据限制或自动统计正确。本研究未上传文件或在实际编辑器核对数值。

sections.title_en: Review the document and the delivered format
sections.title_zh: 检查文档与最终交付格式
sections.en:
The [checker guide updated October 1, 2026](https://help.venngage.com/hc/en-us/articles/18417406336781-Using-the-Accessibility-Checker) opens from File → Accessibility. It flags eleven areas: title, language, alternative text, images of text, reading order, headings, contrast, use of color, links, tables and text size. Expand a flagged category, fix the content and track the items addressed. A green check or manually checked item is not an independent audit of the whole communication.

The [download guide](https://help.venngage.com/hc/en-us/articles/11013171228685-Download-an-Accessible-Design) recommends PDF or a Venngage link and says its PDF downloads follow PDF/UA. PNG/PNG HD does not expose the design’s text/content to screen readers in the same way; add an appropriate description wherever an image is posted. Check actual reading order, link labels, alt text and assistive-technology behavior in the exported artifact. Vendor format claims are not certification that a particular user-created file meets every applicable requirement.
sections.zh:
[2026年10月1日更新的检查指南](https://help.venngage.com/hc/en-us/articles/18417406336781-Using-the-Accessibility-Checker)从File → Accessibility打开，标记标题、语言、替代文字、文字图像、阅读顺序、标题层级、对比度、颜色使用、链接、表格及字号11项。展开问题类别、修改内容并跟踪已处理事项，绿色或手动勾选不等于对全部沟通内容的独立审计。

[下载指南](https://help.venngage.com/hc/en-us/articles/11013171228685-Download-an-Accessible-Design)建议PDF或Venngage链接，并表示PDF下载遵循PDF/UA。PNG/PNG HD不能以同样方式向读屏器暴露文字/内容，发布图片时应加适当描述。应在实际成品检查阅读顺序、链接标签、替代文字及辅助技术行为。厂商格式主张不认证每个用户文件符合所有适用要求。

sections.title_en: Design access is different from export entitlement
sections.title_zh: 能设计与有权导出不同
sections.en:
The [current price page](https://venngage.com/pricing) lists Free with five designs, six image uploads and public-link sharing. Premium adds unlimited designs, 50 image uploads, private sharing and PNG/HD PNG. Business adds PDF/PowerPoint, brand kits, team sharing, folders and password-protected sharing, with 1,000 uploads in the matrix. A free account is suitable for evaluating creation/public sharing, not an assumption of free private downloadable deliverables.

The matrix lists daily shared AI credits of 80 Free, 160 Premium and 1,600 Business, with monthly “up to” figures of 2,400/4,800/48,000. The Free card also calls AI a trial, so continuing free AI eligibility and reset rules need confirmation; do not treat these amounts as unlimited generations or separately stack each AI feature’s credits. Enterprise is custom and offers additional controls, but current member-minimum wording differs between its card and feature text.
sections.zh:
[当前价格页](https://venngage.com/pricing)列Free为5个设计、6次图片上传及公开链接；Premium增加无限设计、50次上传、私密分享及PNG/高清PNG；Business增加PDF/PowerPoint、品牌工具包、团队分享、文件夹、密码保护，矩阵列1,000次上传。免费账户适合评估创作/公开分享，不能假定有免费私密下载交付。

矩阵列共享日AI点数为Free 80、Premium 160、Business 1,600，并给每月“最多”2,400/4,800/48,000；Free卡片同时称AI为试用，因此持续免费AI资格及重置需确认，不能当无限生成或把各AI功能额度另行叠加。Enterprise询价并提供额外控制，但卡片和功能文字对最低人数的表述不一致。

sections.title_en: Compare billed periods and contract services
sections.en:
The normal browser annual selector showed USD Premium $10/month equivalent and Business $24/user/month; switching to Monthly changed them to $19 and $49. These are the viewed offers, with final annual totals/taxes/renewal to confirm at checkout. Enterprise starts at $499/month and its card says minimum ten members, while nearby text says teams of eleven to over one hundred; obtain a written quote for the intended team.

The [actual terms page](https://help.venngage.com/hc/en-us/articles/11017601872781-Terms-of-Service-2-4) is titled version 2.5 despite its older URL. It provides recurring billing until cancellation and no cancellation/partial-period refunds. Enterprise terms require prepayment, sixty days’ written cancellation/nonrenewal notice and potentially additional charges for account management or custom migration, notwithstanding simpler marketing descriptions. A signed order form determines negotiated commitments. Do not infer all enterprise services are included or that a displayed monthly equivalent means month-to-month cancellation.
sections.zh:
正常浏览器年付选项显示美元Premium折合每月$10、Business每用户每月$24，切至Monthly后变为$19和$49。这是本次可见报价，实际年度总额/税费/续费应在结账核查。Enterprise每月$499起，卡片写至少10人，附近文字却写11至100多人，应按目标团队取得书面报价。

[实际条款页](https://help.venngage.com/hc/en-us/articles/11017601872781-Terms-of-Service-2-4)虽URL较旧，标题为2.5版，规定循环扣费直到取消，并无取消/部分账期退款。Enterprise要求预付、提前60天书面取消/不续费，账户管理或定制迁移可能另收费，不能只按简化宣传解读。协商承诺以签署订单为准，不能推定企业服务全部包含或月费折合意味着可按月取消。

sections.title_en: A hosted subscription with user-content responsibilities
sections.title_zh: 有用户内容责任的托管订阅
sections.en:
Terms sections 5 and 8 grant limited service/design rights while retaining Venngage’s platform IP; users reserve their uploaded-content rights and remain responsible for accuracy, legality and third-party permissions. Subscription access is not an open-source license or a transfer of all supplied stock assets. Keep original datasets, approved brand assets and allowed deliverables outside a single hosted account.

Before a team rollout, confirm account membership, private sharing, storage/retention, migration fees and which plan permits the accessible output needed. This research read public pricing and upgraded-editor guides, but did not create an account, test AI, edit/import data, export a PDF/PowerPoint, inspect assistive output or execute team permissions. It does not establish independent compliance or measured business outcomes.
sections.zh:
条款第5及8节授予有限服务/设计使用权，同时保留Venngage平台知识产权；用户保留上传内容权利，并负责准确性、合法性和第三方权限。订阅访问不等于开源许可或转让全部图库素材。应在单一托管账户外保留原始数据、获批品牌素材及允许保存的交付物。

团队采用前应确认成员、私密分享、存储/保留、迁移费用及所需可访问成品对应套餐。本研究实读公开价格和新版编辑器指南，未创建账户、测试AI、编辑/导入数据、导出PDF/PowerPoint、检查辅助技术成品或执行团队权限，不证明独立合规或量化业务成果。
